title: Japanese Miso Fondue
description: A fusion of Japanese and Swiss flavors, this miso fondue is a rich and savory treat.
instructions: In a saucepan, heat the sake, soy sauce, and mirin over low heat.
Add the miso paste and stir until dissolved.
Gradually add in the fondue cheese, stirring constantly.
Continue heating until the cheese is melted and smooth.
Transfer the fondue to a fondue pot or a small ceramic bowl.
Serve with sliced Portuguese bread for dipping.
